task: Welcome to another life changing round of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, make an effort to go east. With that accomplished, ensure that the portal is open. After that, take a trip north. And then, move north. And then, look and see that the passageway inside the cellar is open. And then, move west. And then, recover the teaspoon from the floor of the cookhouse. Alright, thanks!
description:
You find yourself in a playroom. An usual kind of place.

Oh, great. Here's a bed. The bed is usual. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. Hm. Oh well You can see a desk. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. What, you think everything in TextWorld should have stuff on it?

There is an open gateway leading east. There is an open gate leading south.
